record.question: On which day is the National Dengue Day observed every year in India?
record.explanation: Answer C: 16th May. India observes National Dengue Day on 16 May to build awareness of dengue prevention and control. This is the Indian national observance. Reference: https://ncdc.mohfw.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
